world.title: Trump says he slipped away from Air Force One in Turkey due to threat
world.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump disclosed on August 12, 2026, that he secretly changed planes in Turkey due to security threats, as advised by the U.S. Secret Service. He expressed concerns that Air Force One might have been targeted. Despite switching planes, Trump noted that the aircraft he used remained more vulnerable than Air Force One.

world.title: 'I go by Secret Service, military': Trump confirms switching planes in Turkey over Iran threat
world.summary: US President Donald Trump confirmed he was switched to a different aircraft while departing Turkey last month. He stated that he followed instructions from the Secret Service and military due to a potential threat from Iran. The decision was made to ensure his safety during the flight, highlighting the precautions taken in response to security concerns.

world.title: Trump aide says he got ‘firebombed’ by India over remarks against its Russian oil purchases: ‘Don't do that’
world.summary: Trump aide Peter Navarro criticized India for its increased purchases of Russian oil post-invasion of Ukraine, labeling the country the “Maharaja of tariffs.” He claimed India's actions support Russia's war efforts by selling refined products. Navarro's remarks have drawn backlash from India, which he described as having "firebombed" him for his comments regarding its oil trade with Russia.

business.title: Throwback: 6 HCL co-founders, Rs 1.87 lakh, Golf Links barsati as first office
business.summary: HCL co-founder Ajai Chowdhry reflected on the company's origins as it marked 50 years since its founding. In 1976, six founders pooled Rs 1.87 lakh to establish HCL in a barsati in Delhi's Golf Links. Chowdhry emphasized their ambition to create an Indian computer and transform the country's technological landscape, highlighting the company's significant journey since then.

business.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex down 500 pts, Nifty below 24,300; TCS, Max Health top losers
business.summary: The Sensex dropped 500 points, while the Nifty fell below 24,300 in Wednesday's trading. The Nifty MidCap and Nifty SmallCap indices also declined, down 0.3% and 0.21%, respectively. TCS and Max Health were among the top losers. Overall, the market faced significant pressure, reflecting broader economic concerns impacting investor sentiment.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S24 price drops to Rs 35,525 with cashback and exchange offer on Amazon
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy S24 is now priced at Rs 35,525 on Amazon, reduced from its MRP of Rs 74,999. This price drop includes cashback and exchange offers for eligible buyers. The smartphone features 8GB RAM and 128GB storage, powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor. The original listing price was Rs 54,499 before discounts.

technology.title: Microsoft Monthly Security Update (August 2026)
technology.source: Hong Kong Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Centre
technology.summary: Microsoft has issued its August 2026 security update, addressing vulnerabilities in its products. Notably, CVE-2026-68820 is currently being exploited, allowing locally authenticated attackers to execute a specially crafted application that triggers a race condition. If successful, this exploitation could enable attackers to gain SYSTEM privileges on affected systems, posing significant security risks to users.

technology.title: Marvel's Wolverine Limited Edition PS5 Console Announced, Plus Physical Disc Drive Covers
technology.summary: Marvel's Wolverine will launch alongside a limited edition PS5 console bundle on September 15. This exclusive bundle includes cover plates designed for both digital and disc drive versions of the PS5. The new game, developed by Insomniac, is highly anticipated and will feature Wolverine as the central character, appealing to fans of the Marvel franchise.

sports.title: Watch: Saif Ali Khan shows off his bowling skills on London cricket field; fans say, 'Khandani cricketer hai'
sports.summary: Saif Ali Khan is in London, where a video of him demonstrating his bowling skills on a cricket field has gained popularity among fans. The actor was dressed in traditional cricket attire while showcasing his abilities. Fans expressed their admiration, with some commenting that he is a "Khandani cricketer," highlighting his family's connection to the sport.

sports.title: Chelsea have ‘no interest’ in signing Myles Lewis-Skelly from Arsenal - report
sports.summary: Chelsea has reportedly expressed no interest in acquiring Myles Lewis-Skelly from Arsenal, particularly at a price of £45 million. Arsenal recently made a significant investment by signing midfielder Bruno Guimarães from Newcastle United. The situation highlights the shifting dynamics in player negotiations, with Chelsea distancing itself from potential moves involving Lewis-Skelly amid Arsenal's recent spending activities.

health.title: National team deployed in Gujarat to investigate, control and treat Chandipura Virus outbreak
health.summary: A national team, including experts from the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), has been deployed to Gujarat to investigate the Chandipura virus outbreak linked to acute encephalitis syndrome cases. The team will examine the disease's source, transmission, and treatment options. Additionally, both Gujarat and Rajasthan have enhanced their outbreak response measures to address the situation effectively.

health.title: Never-Before-Seen Type of Amyloid May Explain a Devastating Form of Alzheimer's
health.summary: Researchers have identified a previously unknown type of amyloid associated with a rare form of Alzheimer's disease, observed in only two families and a few individuals. This discovery may enhance understanding of the disease's complexity and variability among patients. The findings could lead to improved diagnostic methods and potential treatment strategies for this devastating condition.

health.title: Lung cancer is not only about smoking: Doctor explains the risks hiding in your air, home and daily routine
health.summary: Lung cancer is primarily linked to smoking, but other factors contribute to its development, including family history, secondhand smoke, radon exposure, air pollution, and certain workplace hazards. The World Health Organization reported 2.5 million new cases and 1.8 million deaths from lung cancer in 2022. Preventive measures focus on reducing harmful exposures rather than relying on specific foods or supplements.

science.title: Nanoglass Interfaces Expand the Design Space for Amorphous Materials
science.summary: Nanoglasses utilize nanoscale glass grains and unique glass-glass interfaces to create controllable heterogeneity in amorphous materials. This approach allows for the tuning of mechanical properties, atomic transport, magnetism, optics, and catalysis through interface engineering. The introduction of high excess volume at these interfaces provides researchers with enhanced control over the functional properties of nanoglasses compared to conventional glasses.

science.title: The Brain Possesses More Self-Healing Power Than Previously Thought
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Zurich have discovered that the brain can regenerate more effectively than previously believed after injuries or autoimmune diseases. In a mouse model, they found that specific support and supply cells migrate to damaged brain areas, repopulating them by initially bringing only newly formed cell nuclei. This suggests enhanced self-healing capabilities of the brain.

science.title: SANS Syndrome: Astronaut Vision Loss & Eye Damage Explained
science.summary: NASA reports that approximately 70% of astronauts on the International Space Station experience vision changes due to Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-Ocular Syndrome (SANS). This condition involves swelling at the back of the eyes and poses significant health risks for astronauts spending extended periods in space. Ongoing research aims to understand and mitigate the effects of long-duration spaceflight on vision.

entertainment.title: The WGA Slams David Ellison's Plan to Pull Paramount From California
entertainment.summary: The Writers Guild of America has responded to Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison's threat to relocate Paramount from California. Ellison stated he would begin this process on October 1 if California Attorney General Rob Bonta did not engage in negotiations to resolve the ongoing antitrust issues. The Guild's response highlights the tensions surrounding the situation.

entertainment.title: Arjun Bijlani reacts to dating rumours with Mouni Roy; says, ‘I’ve a family and she’s also going through a tough phase’
entertainment.summary: Television actor Arjun Bijlani addressed dating rumors with his friend and former co-star Mouni Roy. The speculation arose after a video of them leaving a dinner together circulated online. Bijlani clarified that he has a family and mentioned that Roy is currently facing personal challenges. He emphasized their friendship and the importance of respecting their individual circumstances.

entertainment.title: Kangana Ranaut takes 'lomdi' jibe at actor Naseeruddin Shah, says ‘Fights for neighbour country’
entertainment.summary: Kangana Ranaut criticized veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah, referring to him as "lomdi" and suggesting he supports a neighboring country. She expressed that being called a dog is preferable to being labeled a "lomdi" during current times. This remark comes amid ongoing discussions regarding the silence of Bollywood's top actors on various issues. Ranaut's comments have sparked further debate.
